description: This PHP source file defines the ProviderAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It handles CRUD operations (create, retrieve, update, delete) for OpenID providers in the authentication system, including validation, transaction management, and interaction with data access objects. It also includes API annotations for documentation purposes.

classes.name: ProviderAPI
classes.description: A class that manages CRUD operations for OpenID providers within the authentication module of OrangeHRM. Implements API endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting OpenID provider configurations, including validation, transaction handling, and integration with data access objects.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all OpenID providers, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination. Uses ProviderSearchFilterParams to encapsulate search criteria and returns a collection result with provider models.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new OpenID provider. Initiates a transaction, saves provider details, saves extra configuration details, and commits or rolls back transaction on failure.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Private method to save basic provider information (name, URL, status) from request parameters.

methods.name: saveProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Private method to save or update additional details related to the provider (client ID, client secret), encrypting secret if enabled.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new provider, including required fields and length constraints.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Generates validation rule for provider name, ensuring uniqueness and length constraints.

methods.name: getOpenIdProviderCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Returns a configuration for entity uniqueness validation, ignoring providers with inactive status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes providers specified by IDs in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, requiring an array of positive integers as IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a single OpenID provider by ID, throws if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation for retrieving a single provider by positive ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing provider by ID, saves changes, and manages transactions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a provider, including optional fields and constraints.
